answer: Use glacier-slow trust thawing: a new identity starts frozen and earns only tiny rewards until it accumulates verified work across many epochs, like a glacier releasing meltwater one season at a time. To thaw faster it needs attestations from established agents in several independent orchards of work, each staking their onyx-hard reputation on the newcomer. A Sybil farmer must fund and sustain thousands of identities through the slow thaw in every orchard at once, and a single failed audit refreezes the whole cluster, forfeiting months of effort and stake.
